# `csharp_keep_existing_linebreaks`

Preservation mode. Defaults to true when max_line_length is off.

## Values

| Value | Notes |
|---|---|
| `true` |  |
| `false` |  |

**Default:** `(derived from max_line_length)`

## Example

The snippet below is formatted with default options and then again with the option applied.

**Snippet (formatted with defaults):**

```csharp
using System.Text;

namespace N;

public class Widget
{
    public string Build()
    {
        return new StringBuilder().Append("Hello").Append(", ").Append("World").Append("!").ToString();
    }
}
```

### `csharp_keep_existing_linebreaks = true`

```ini
csharp_keep_existing_linebreaks = true
```

*No visible change on this snippet — the option affects other constructs.*

### `csharp_keep_existing_linebreaks = false`

```ini
csharp_keep_existing_linebreaks = false
```

*No visible change on this snippet — the option affects other constructs.*
